extracted.subtask_description: Advice and evaluative criteria for crafting short stories, focused on voice, character authenticity, and risk-taking, plus practical drafting/editing steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk-Taking & Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that subvert rules or push boundaries. "I enjoy a story with notions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ignore prescriptive rules; 'Write from the guts. Take all the risks.' Valued are stories that challenge conventions and introduce fresh or daring ideas rather than safe, formulaic plots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic Characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully drawn characters over tired tropes. Believability matters most — readers must sense the writer genuinely believes in their characters' reality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid stock or tired tropes; focus on nuance and internal truth so characters feel lived-in and credible to the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: The most critical element: "an authentic, and ideally intriguing, voice." Carson loves narratives that feel like intimate confessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize finding a distinctive, believable narrative voice; voice should feel genuine and engaging, like an intimate confession rather than an affectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read Aloud to Test Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Read work aloud to verify voice authenticity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use vocalization as a diagnostic: if the language and rhythm sound true when spoken, the voice is likely authentic; awkward or stilted phrasing becomes more apparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous Revision / 'Excavating for Treasure'
rubrics_metrics.description: Edit rigorously, treating revision like 'excavating for treasure.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Approach revision as discovery — dig into drafts to unearth stronger material, clarify voice and character, and remove anything that feels inauthentic or redundant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust Your Unique Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Trust that each writer possesses unique stories only they can tell.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lean into personal perspective and the particularities only you can supply; this uniqueness often yields the most compelling material.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Formula; Use Intuition and Courage
rubrics_metrics.description: No formula guarantees success. Writing requires intuition, courage, and willingness to challenge conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat rules as flexible rather than prescriptive; be willing to take creative risks guided by intuition rather than checklist-driven composition.
